Messages.Author: SteveHarris
Messages.Body:
When playing Diabolic Lure at superior, does the acting minion's
controller burn the pool when the card is played OR when the pact
counters are burned?

Diabolic Lure
Reaction
[aus] Reduce a bleed against you by 1
[dai] Requires an infernal vampire. Only usable when this vampire
successfully blocks. Put 4 pact counters on the acting minion. If the
number of pact counters equals or exceeds his or her capacity or cost,
burn them to make him or her infernal.
[DAI] As [dai] above, ant the acting minion's controller burns 1 pool
